adjudication.rationale: Looking at line 550 in the diff (around the merge deletion path), the code uses `booking.references.find((reference) => reference.type.includes('_calendar'))` which returns only the first matching calendar reference. However, the PR changes the system to support multiple destination calendars (as seen throughout the diff where `destinationCalendar` becomes an array). When merging bookings with multiple calendar references, only the first old calendar event would be deleted, leaving orphaned events for other hosts. This is a real bug because the rest of the code in this file properly handles multiple references using `.filter()` (e.g., lines 493-494), but this specific deletion path was not updated to handle the array case.
